Joins 2025 code violation counts per tract with CDC PLACES adult high blood pressure prevalence and total population, computes the violation rate per 1,000 residents, and returns the paired tract set with the overall correlation and paired tract count.
sql:
WITH violation_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_4fd17e'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
health_data AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_4fd17e_m2_cdc
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  CASE
    WHEN h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0
    THEN COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) * 1000.0 / h.totalpopulation
  END AS code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents,
  COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count,
  h.totalpopulation AS total_population_residents,
  h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  CORR(
    CASE
      WHEN h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0
      THEN COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) * 1000.0 / h.totalpopulation
    END,
    h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  ) OVER () AS violation_bp_correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN violation_counts v ON t.geoid = v.geoid
LEFT JOIN health_data h ON t.geoid = h.geoid
WHERE h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL
  AND h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
  AND h.totalpopulation > 0
ORDER BY code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, t.name
